cases.study_information: Predict 24-hour CSF PGRN concentration (pg/mL) for sandwich1_h24, sandwich2_h24 and kappa3_h24. Early CSF measurements, matched 24-hour PBS/RIPA brain fractions and the older PTV11 reference are visible. Source constructs differ in payload and fusion architecture. Brain fractions use pg/mg wet tissue; they cannot be equated to CSF concentration or unbound partitioning. No 48-hour results are supplied.
